tasks.message: Research-only. Preserve original historical findings as hypotheses. No use of patient data, no patient interventions, no treatment claims. Work only in the isolated Madoev workspace. Do not change Delta or nginx-qa main. Every deliverable must include reproducible commands and changed Git commit. PILOT: Inspect projects/madoev-eeg/analysis/analyze_eeg_ar.py and test_analysis.py, run the existing synthetic AR and artifact-QC tests in an isolated workspace, add or improve tests if needed, and write projects/madoev-eeg/docs/PILOT_AR04_EVIDENCE.md containing exact commands, Python/dependency versions, expected vs observed AR orders, pass/fail, data safety checks, and commit hash. If dependencies or execution are unavailable, report BLOCKED_EXTERNAL, never claim tests passed without output.
